title: Preserve Vaporize Xcode app-test source-to-install parity
description: Vaporize source already dispatched `test xcode --artifact app` to Xcode, but the installed binary was stale. Refresh initially failed because the CLI installer discarded `--scratch-path` and rebuilt from the incompatible local world state. The installer now carries the isolated workspace through replacement build and product lookup; the refreshed installed binary reaches xcodebuild for app-test requests. The separate Launch Review Xcode world-state migration remains tracked by bug-launch-review-vaporize-generated-xcodeproj-world-state-stale-2026-08-18.
acceptanceCriteria: The installed Vaporize binary accepts a macOS app Xcode project or workspace, scheme, and destination in test mode.
A forced CLI replacement uses the same isolated SwiftPM workspace for build and build-product discovery.
The app-test route reaches Xcode without claiming an installed app, release, or human approval.
The separate Launch Review world-state migration is not conflated with this tool source-to-install repair.
